inherited_v015_writer_model_experimental.basis: existing bounded M3C models, unchanged party layout, and live record confirmation of friendship, Attack IV, and an HP EV edit within the composed canary

ability_selection.reason: no exact-build-backed valid alternate for retained Bulbasaur was available; changing selector would be speculative

reusable_experimental_editor.status: Fast Lab experimental; exact v0.22 ROM profile gated
write_fields: exact retained canary save SHA-256 only
target level 5->6; species transition sets coherent EXP 134->135; explicit EXP write is limited to 134->179
friendship 50->51; 50->53 only in the exact composed canary
HP EV 0->8 only in the exact composed canary
fail_closed: ball, markings, nature mint, other IV/EV values, and held-item writes
move changes other than slot 0 Tackle 33->Pound 1
hyper-training, other input saves, and unproven combinations
reusable_experimental_editor.level_exp_policy: Only the exact retained canary input is writable. EXP and stored level are preserved unless the evidenced level 5->6 / EXP 134->179 transition is requested. Existing baseline EXP 134 / stored level 5 discrepancy is preserved for unrelated edits.
reusable_experimental_editor.species_policy: Only species 1 and 2; preserve level and other fields, set minimum coherent EXP when needed, preserve selector 0, recompute cached stats.
reusable_experimental_editor.move_policy: Only slot 0 Tackle 33->Pound 1 is writable; preserve PP-Up count and set PP to the evidenced maximum.
reusable_experimental_editor.current_hp_policy: Reuses M3C maximum-HP delta policy; preserves missing HP, keeps fainted HP zero, and rejects a max-HP decrease outside supported behavior.
reusable_experimental_editor.checksum_policy: Recompute active logical section 1 checksum only; active slot, counters, other bytes and footer preserved.

inventory.status: FAST LAB EXPERIMENTAL V0.22 INVENTORY QUANTITY; one existing regular-pocket Potion slot read/edit/live-confirmed

normal_save_pair.lineage_evidence: both slots verify independently; counters advance 1->2; old slot retained and section rotation observed

saved_representation.fields: little-endian u16 item ID followed by u16 encrypted quantity
saved_representation.quantity_xor: source-backed low-u16 quantity XOR; direct representation corroborated for observed key 0
saved_representation.observed_empty_shape: following 4-byte entry and remainder through section payload end are zero
saved_representation.capacity: not established; only live-correlated slot 0 with a single populated Potion is supported
saved_representation.checksum_implication: section 13 checksum covers 0x450 bytes; observed quantity at 0xADC is outside it, so no checksum field changed

differential.method: compare both checksum-validated slots after reconstructing payloads by logical section ID, not physical offsets
differential.unique_inventory_transition: section 13 offset 0xADC changes from {item 13, quantity 1} to {item 13, quantity 2}; next entry and remaining payload tail are zero in both slots
differential.other_changes: normal-save transition also changes Money 3000->3032, party/runtime/save bookkeeping and slot/counter rotation; these were retained, not masked
differential.alternative_hits: other raw item-ID-like sequences either do not transition 13/1->13/2 or lack the surrounding single-record shape

quantity_write.byte_diff: one quantity low byte 0x02->0x03; item ID, slot, checksums, other bytes unchanged
quantity_write.live_confirmation: exact v0.22 ROM accepted output; live slot 0 item ID 13 quantity 3; party record and Money matched offline; source ROM/save and probe working copy unchanged

reusable_editor.limits: exact v0.22 ROM SHA gate; exact retained Potion-bearing save SHA-256 only; key 0; existing Potion slot 0 quantity 2->3 only; rejects other entries and nonzero tail bytes; new output path only
reusable_editor.checksum_policy: section 13 checksum unchanged because edited field is outside covered payload; verifier rechecks all section checksums

findings: Exact v0.22 ROM retains the BPRJ FireRed header and demo documentation identifies CFRU-JP/DPE-JP as bases.
The verifier-supported section layout is corroborated at runtime by matching live Money, party count, and all 100 bytes of party[0].
No migration was visible in the disposable load; migration behavior beyond this retained save was not analyzed.
The live regular-items pocket is source-backed and the saved Potion quantity is located by a same-lineage slot differential; broader pocket capacity, item coverage, and key support remain unproven.
